name: ezil-chat
description: OpenCode-powered chat panel for EZiL OS: streaming turns, tool cards, permissions, diffs and model routing in the secondary sidebar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: EZiL Chat runs an agent with file and shell access, so it waits for workspace trust.

commands.title: EZiL Chat: Add Selection to Chat

ezilChat.opencodePath.markdownDescription: Path to the pinned `opencode` binary the extension spawns with `opencode serve`. Ignored when `#ezilChat.serverUrl#` is set.

ezilChat.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Attach to an already running OpenCode v2 server (for example `http://127.0.0.1:4096`) instead of spawning one. Set `#ezilChat.serverPassword#` if that server requires basic auth.

ezilChat.serverPassword.markdownDescription: Basic-auth password (`OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`) for `#ezilChat.serverUrl#`. Spawned servers get a random password automatically.

ezilChat.configPath.markdownDescription: Optional `opencode.json` passed to the spawned server as `OPENCODE_CONFIG`. Leave empty to use OpenCode's normal config lookup (including the managed `/etc/opencode/opencode.json`).

ezilChat.defaultAgent.description: Agent selected for new sessions (build, plan, or any primary agent the server reports).

ezilChat.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for new sessions as `providerID/modelID` (for example `azure/claude-sonnet-4-5`). Empty uses the server's default model.

ezilChat.autoStart.description: Start the OpenCode server when VS Code finishes loading. When off, the server starts the first time the panel is opened.

ezilChat.revealOnStartup.description: Reveal the EZiL Chat panel the first time this window activates the extension.

scripts.build: bun run build:extension && bun run build:webview
scripts.build:webview: bun build src/webview/main.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/webview.js && cp src/webview/style.css dist/webview.css
scripts.package:vsix: bun run build && bunx @vscode/vsce@4.0.0 package --no-dependencies --out ezil-chat-0.1.0.vsix
